title: Illustration / Shape language / Simplicity
slide_intent: Keep enough detail for recognition while removing unnecessary parts because both abstraction and clutter can obscure a subject.
strategic_value: A restrained shape count can make Duolingo illustrations recognizable and practical to produce.
demonstration: Three cat constructions are labeled six, fifteen and thirty shapes, with the middle example approved and the others criticized.
practical_value: Judge what each shape contributes rather than adopting the example’s count as a universal target.

content_islands.name: Three cat specimens
content_islands.spec: Arrange the simplified, balanced and detailed cats from left to right on the pale panel.

content_islands.name: Counts and judgments
content_islands.spec: Keep each numerical shape count with its blue or red evaluative caption.

content_islands.name: Simplicity rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation of making each shape matter at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says each shape should strengthen the illustration and calls simplicity both stylistically and practically necessary.
reference_purposes.Application: The three cat examples show too little, sufficient and excessive detail.

ingredient.name: Illustration detail
ingredient.role: Make the subject legible without unnecessary construction.
ingredient.application: Use the fewest shapes that still communicate the subject and its character.
ingredient.scope: The six/fifteen/thirty counts describe these cat examples; fifteen is not a universal limit or prescribed count.
